indicator_name: Banks' loan portfolio quality: debt by days past due and provisions, by borrower type
description: Структура качества ссудного портфеля банков: основной долг по срокам просрочки и провизии, по типам заёмщиков
unit: billion KZT, at the start of the month
methodology: NBK formId=47, summed over IFRS risk stages. Items <DEBT|PROVISION>.<borrower>[.<days past due>], DEBT and PROVISION over all borrowers, <DEBT|PROVISION>.<days past due>. Dated by report_date (1st of the month after the stock date). Monthly from 2026-01; also 2025-07-01 and 2025-10-01. DEBT.HH at 2026-09-01 is 26 471.8 bn KZT, of which DPD90 1 220.0 (4.61 %) and DPD1_30 680.2 -- equal to the ARDFM bulletin's retail-loan table (checked 2026-11-07).
